'''Christopher Aulepp''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Utah tournament]] in March 2001 with [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|TIGIH mad scout lovin' deck]], according to Casey Barson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1998">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-01-smeg-vs-mothra-battle-royaled1998/ smeg-vs-mothra-battle-royale], DeckTech (Casey "Smeg" Barson, 1 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-01-smeg-vs-mothra-battle-royaled1998/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
